info.title: delivery-bff
info.description: Extracted by reading Express route registrations directly (tier 4). Version from package.json. One public route. The service proxies a carrier tracking API with 3 retries and degrades to a stale/default response instead of erroring.

get.description: Calls syncDeliveryStatus(ordNo), which GETs {CARRIER_API}/tracking/{ordNo} with a 3s timeout, up to MAX_RETRY=3 attempts with 500ms*attempt backoff. On total failure it returns 200 with a fabricated PREPARING status and stale:true — never a 5xx, and with no alerting ('3회 실패 시 포기한다. 별도 알림은 없다.').

200.description: Carrier status, or a degraded fallback

DeliveryStatus.description: Returned verbatim from the carrier response body; not validated.

StaleDeliveryStatus.description: Fallback after 3 failed carrier calls. Comment says '마지막 저장 값을 반환한다' (return the last stored value) but there is no store — status is hardcoded to PREPARING.

order-service.note: Generated 2022-11-08 from the stale order-service spec. Path does not match today's OrderController (@RequestMapping("/orders") + POST /{ordNo}/cancel = /orders/{ordNo}/cancel, no /api/v1 prefix). Its OrderStatus union is also 2022-era. Regeneration tracked as SF-4901, '미착수' (not started). Not reachable from any HTTP route in this service — requestCancel is exported but never called.
